Refactored [BuildHeap.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/012_building_heap_from_array/BuildHeap.java:1) so the public API stays the same, but the internals are now organized around a private `HeapView` instead of a loose set of static helpers. That `HeapView` owns the array, cached size, index calculations, `siftDown`, and heap validation, which makes the implementation more cohesive and removes most of the parameter passing.

Verification passed with `javac BuildHeap.java BuildHeapDemo.java`, `java -cp . BuildHeapDemo`, `java -cp . BuildHeapDemo 7 2 11 1 9`, and `java -cp . BuildHeapDemo 7 two 11`. The observable behavior is unchanged except for the already-added CLI usage message on invalid input.
